edits.why: version pin moved to the latest pydantic

edits.old: As of pydantic 1.10, `Field(regex=...)` is the way to add a pattern check.
edits.new: As of pydantic 2.0, `Field(pattern=...)` is the way to add a pattern check.
edits.why: Field regex was renamed to pattern in pydantic 2

edits.old: The `regex` argument does the check, so a bad code raises a ValidationError.
edits.new: The `pattern` argument does the check, so a bad code raises a ValidationError.
edits.why: the argument name changed with the Field rename

edits.old: `dict` returns the fields as a plain dict.
edits.new: `model_dump` returns the fields as a plain dict.

edits.old: `root_validator` runs after the fields are checked.
edits.new: `model_validator` with `mode="after"` runs after the fields are checked.

edits.old: A custom root type uses `__root__` in the class body.
edits.new: A custom root type subclasses `RootModel` with its type in brackets.

edits.old: `__root__` declares the one value the model wraps.
edits.new: `RootModel` declares the one value the model wraps.
edits.why: the root value is now declared by RootModel
